title: Sila Cuba Lagi
mood: fed up and shouting about it
subject: a toll gate rejecting your Touch 'n Go card five times on a Monday morning while a sand lorry and twenty cars honk behind you
caption: Malay pop-punk in the fast skate-punk style. Double-tracked distorted guitars playing palm-muted downstroke power chords in the verses and open ringing chords in the chorus, a melodic electric bass running between the chords, and skate-punk two-beat drums in the verses that open up to a straight-eighth beat on the crash-ride with the snare on two and four in the chorus, with fast tom fills and stop-start breaks. Loud and tight, guitars panned hard left and right, drums punchy and dry, the lead vocal forward over the wall. Earnest, slightly nasal male lead with whoa-oh gang vocals and shout-along hooks. 176 BPM, A major. Fed up and shouting about it. No autotune, no trap drums, no synths, no slow emo ballad section, no metal growls.
lyrics:
[Intro - palm-muted guitar and snare count-in]

[Verse 1]
Isnin, pukul enam empat puluh pagi, plaza tol, lorong paling kanan
Aku tap kad, palang tak naik, skrin kuning berkelip
"Sila cuba lagi" - aku cuba lagi, aku cuba sampai lima kali
Belakang aku lori pasir, belakang lori dua puluh kereta

[Pre-Chorus]
Hon pertama, hon kedua, lepas tu satu lebuh raya
Whoa-oh, whoa-oh, aku tak boleh undur

[Chorus]
Sila cuba lagi!
Baki aku ada, semalam aku dah tambah nilai
Kad ni sama umur dengan kereta aku, dua-dua dah penat
Aku keluar kereta, angkat tangan, "Maaf, bang! Maaf semua!"

[Verse 2]
Pegawai tol keluar dari pondok, jalan perlahan macam hari Ahad
Dia ambil kad aku, gosok kat seluar, tap sekali - palang naik
Dia tak cakap apa-apa, dia cuma angkat kening
Lori pasir hon panjang macam dia yang menang

[Bridge - stop-start breaks, gang shout]
Pasang SmartTAG! (Pasang SmartTAG!)
Esok aku naik LRT! (Tipu! Tipu!)

[Chorus]
Sila cuba lagi!
Baki aku ada, semalam aku dah tambah nilai
Kad ni sama umur dengan kereta aku, dua-dua dah penat
Selasa pagi, lorong sama, skrin sama: "Sila cuba lagi"

[Outro - full band, one last whoa-oh, then stop]
Whoa-oh, whoa-oh
Seluar aku pun dah tahu kerja dia
[Song ends abruptly]
